title: Doc Edgerton, EG&G and filming the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: Edertton had developed a revolutionary use of stroboscopic cameras that along with other pioneering wartime technology ended up being used in the Manhattan project.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels tells of Harold 'Doc' Edgerton, an engineer at MIT, a leading technical university, who he says developed a new way of using stroboscopic cameras, which take extremely fast flash photographs. According to Michels, this and other wartime technology ended up being used in the Manhattan Project, the secret US effort of the 1940s to build the atomic bomb, with links to the wartime science chief Vannevar Bush and to a company called EG&G. He tells it to trace how the people around the bomb program were connected to later secret work.
